name: SpongeBob Burning Paper
look: Four panels in a 2x2 grid from SpongeBob SquarePants. Top left: a yellow hand holds up a blank sheet of paper. Top right: SpongeBob reads it with an annoyed squint. Bottom left: he smiles and drops it into a fire. Bottom right: it burns as he grins.
use: Rejects an unwelcome fact, opinion or reminder. The blank paper holds the thing SpongeBob doesn't want to hear, and he reads it, scowls, then happily burns it.
slots: text on the blank paper in the first panel: the unwelcome fact or opinion
examples: Your screen time was up 40% this week
Reminder: your gym membership renews tomorrow
describe: spongebob reading a paper then throwing it in the fire
spongebob burns a note he doesn't like
four panel spongebob holding up a blank paper
sponge reads a letter angrily and sets it on fire
cartoon tossing a page into a campfire with a smile
origin: Stills from the animated series SpongeBob SquarePants.
